name: al-xliff-studio
description: Visual XLIFF editing, AL source translation hover/navigation, project-wide translation dashboard, terminology glossary, quality assurance with suppressions, synchronization, translation memory, review workflows, and VS Code AI translation support for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central AL apps.

alXliffStudio.xliffGlob.description: Glob used to find translation XLIFF files.

alXliffStudio.excludeGlob.description: Glob excluded from XLIFF processing. The generated .g.xlf should normally stay excluded.

alXliffStudio.hover.enabled.description: Show translations for AL Caption, ToolTip, Label, and other translatable string literals on hover. Each language links directly to the matching translation unit in AL Xliff Studio.

alXliffStudio.treatNeedsTranslationAsMis.description: Treat empty/new/needs-translation XLIFF targets as missing. Review/adaptation/l10n states and non-empty targets without a state are preserved for human review and are not sent to AI.

alXliffStudio.setTranslatedState.description: Set filled target elements to state=translated.

alXliffStudio.ai.enabled.description: Use a VS Code language model only after no Developer-comment translation, no companion .lng exact match, and no exact project glossary match was found.

alXliffStudio.debug.enabled.description: Enable AL Xliff Studio debug logging. When enabled, raw AI translation prompts, raw model responses, parse results, and errors are written to .alxliffstudio/debug/ai-debug.log. The log can contain project translation text and is excluded from Git by default.

alXliffStudio.debug.performance.enabled.description: Enable detailed performance tracing for AL Xliff Studio. Timings, phases, long-running operations, webview render durations, document versions, unit counts, and memory snapshots are written to .alxliffstudio/debug/performance.log.

alXliffStudio.debug.performance.slowThre.description: Performance debug threshold in milliseconds. Operations or phases at or above this duration are marked SLOW in performance.log. Only used when performance debugging is enabled.

alXliffStudio.performance.workerThreads..description: Run XLIFF parsing and Quality Check in a worker thread for very large XLIFF files so the VS Code extension host remains responsive.
Minimum approximate XLIFF text size in MiB at which AL Xliff Studio offloads parsing and Quality Check to a worker thread.
Minimum trans-unit count at which AL Xliff Studio offloads parsing and Quality Check to a worker thread.

alXliffStudio.performance.documentSessio.description: Approximate memory budget in MiB for cached parsed XLIFF DocumentSession snapshots. Active editor sessions stay pinned; older background/dashboard snapshots are evicted first when the budget is exceeded.

alXliffStudio.ai.vendor.description: Preferred VS Code language-model vendor. Leave empty to allow any vendor.

alXliffStudio.ai.modelId.description: Optional exact model id. Use the Select Translation AI Model command to set it.

alXliffStudio.ai.batchSize.description: Number of source strings per AI translation request.

alXliffStudio.ai.usage.enabled.description: Collect token usage for AL Xliff Studio AI translation requests and persist project statistics in .alxliffstudio/ai-usage.json.

alXliffStudio.ai.context.enabled.description: Add structured Business Central/XLIFF context to AI requests, including generator path, Developer notes, nearby units, translation-memory examples, current target metadata, placeholders, maxwidth, and glossary terms.

alXliffStudio.ai.context.nearbyUnits.description: Maximum number of nearby trans-units from the same AL object included as AI context.

alXliffStudio.ai.context.translationMemo.description: Maximum number of similar confirmed companion .lng translations included as AI examples.

alXliffStudio.ai.context.minimumMemorySi.description: Minimum similarity percentage for a companion .lng entry to be included as an AI context example. This does not accept the entry as a fuzzy translation.

alXliffStudio.ai.context.sameSourceConte.description: Maximum number of other trans-units with the same English source included to help disambiguate context-specific translations.

alXliffStudio.ai.context.maxCharactersPe.description: Approximate maximum structured context size per AI translation item. Broad context is trimmed before authoritative notes and generator metadata.

alXliffStudio.validation.checkDuplicateI.description: Warn and skip a file when it contains duplicate trans-unit ids.

alXliffStudio.validation.checkDuplicateG.description: Warn and skip a file when it contains duplicate Xliff Generator notes.

alXliffStudio.validation.checkMaxWidth.description: Warn when a filled target text is longer than the trans-unit's maxwidth attribute.

alXliffStudio.fuzzyMatch.enabled.description: Fall back to the closest similarity match in the companion .lng file after Developer comments, exact .lng lookup, and exact glossary lookup. Fuzzy matches are staged for review.

alXliffStudio.fuzzyMatch.minimumQuality.description: Minimum similarity percentage (Levenshtein-based) required to accept a fuzzy translation-memory match.

alXliffStudio.sourceChangeDetection.enab.description: Compare already-translated trans-units against the sibling *.g.xlf file by id and flag state=needs-l10n when the source text changed.

alXliffStudio.provenance.enabled.description: Record and display translation provenance/history. When disabled, AL Xliff Studio does not append Provenance notes to XLIFF files; existing provenance notes are left untouched and hidden from the regular Notes column.

alXliffStudio.glossary.enabled.description: Use the project terminology glossary for exact translation lookup, AI terminology context, and terminology validation.

alXliffStudio.glossary.path.description: Optional custom path to the project terminology glossary. When empty, AL Xliff Studio uses <AL project>/.alxliffstudio/glossary.json and migrates a single legacy .al-xliff-glossary.json automatically.

alXliffStudio.quality.autoRun.enabled.description: Automatically run Quality Check for translation XLIFF files when the workspace opens and refresh diagnostics after XLIFF saves/file changes, glossary changes, workspace-folder changes, and relevant Quality/Glossary settings changes.

alXliffStudio.quality.problemsNavigation.description: Offer “AL Xliff Studio: Show translation unit” as a Quick Fix for AL Xliff Studio diagnostics in the VS Code Problems view. When disabled, diagnostics remain visible but no translation-unit navigation metadata or Quick Fix is provided.

alXliffStudio.quality.maxProblemsDiagnos.description: Maximum number of AL Xliff Studio Quality Check diagnostics published to the VS Code Problems view per XLIFF file. The full Quality Check result remains available in the XLIFF Editor.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkSourceEqualsT.description: Quality Check: warn when source and target contain the same text (ignored when source and target languages are the same).

alXliffStudio.quality.checkWhitespace.description: Quality Check: warn when leading or trailing whitespace differs between source and target.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkRepeatedWhite.description: Quality Check: warn about repeated spaces/tabs in the target when the source does not contain repeated horizontal whitespace.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkDeveloperComm.description: Quality Check: warn when a translation differs from the unambiguous Developer Note suggestion for its target language.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkPunctuation.description: Quality Check: warn when final punctuation from the source is missing or different in the target.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkPlaceholderOr.description: Legacy setting retained for compatibility. Placeholder order is unrestricted and no order warning is emitted.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkFormattingSeq.description: Quality Check: report lost or added actual line breaks and AL backslash line-break markers. C-style escape spellings are not validated.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkLengthDeviati.description: Quality Check: warn about unusually strong target/source length deviations using conservative thresholds for non-trivial text.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkNabResidues.description: Quality Check: warn about malformed/stale NAB workflow markers or NAB notes left on completed translations.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkInconsistentT.description: Quality Check: warn when the same source text is translated differently within the XLIFF file.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkSharedTargets.description: Quality Check: flag potentially suspicious cases where the same meaningful target is used for different source texts.

alXliffStudio.quality.checkCopiedSourceT.description: Quality Check: optionally flag likely untranslated English words copied from the source into a non-English target. Disabled by default because product/technical terms can create false positives.
